test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

He applied for the __vacant __post.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Occupied**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word.
 
• The word **Vacant **means empty or not occupied
 
• The word **Occupied **means being used or busy
 
• The meaning of word Vacant is opposite of meaning of word vacant,** hence the correct answer is Occupied.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Indistinct **means not clear or perfectly defined.

*Example *: I can hear a **Indistinct **sound.

 
• The word **Empty **means not filled or occupied.

*Example *: There's an **empty **glass on the table.

 
• The word **Lucid **means clearly understandable and expressible .

*Example *: I had a **lucid **dream today for the first time.
